card.name: Words before 'Information' in section titles
card.fires_on: The word just before 'Information' in label section titles and cross-references, such as Patient Counseling Information or Prescribing Information.

modes.label: Counseling cross-reference
modes.description: 'Counseling' in the bracketed pointer to Patient Counseling Information (17).

modes.label: Prescribing or administration heading
modes.description: 'Prescribing' or 'Administration' in headings or phrases that end in Information.
